verdict.rationale: Harbor Compliance's registered agent service documents that state forms come pre-filled with Harbor's registered agent address, so the provider's address goes on state filings instead of the founder's own. It is offered as a national registered agent service. The privacy outcome of keeping a home address off the public record is only implied by substituting the agent address, not stated outright. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of the privacy/address-shielding benefit, clarity on which filing address fields (registered vs. principal/mailing) can use the provider's address, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
